prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a parking lot collision in Houston, Texas, and has concussion. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1091; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather not give my name on a recording if that's okay. You have my policy and claim information.
Q: That's fine. Can you describe where you were when the collision happened?
A: I was in the parking lot of a grocery store here in Houston, driving slowly toward an open space near the front entrance.
Q: What were the weather and lighting conditions?
A: It was dry and still daylight, maybe late afternoon. The lot was fairly busy.
Q: Tell me what you saw right before the impact.
A: A silver sedan was backing out of a space on my right. I braked, but he kept coming and his rear bumper hit my front driver's side corner.
Q: Did you have any contact with the other vehicle before the impact?
A: No, I didn't touch anything else. I'd come to a near stop when it happened.
Q: How fast would you estimate you were going?
A: Maybe five or ten miles an hour. I wasn't rushing.
Q: Did you hit your head or lose consciousness?
A: My head hit the side window hard. I didn't black out completely, but I was dazed for a few minutes.
Q: How are you feeling now?
A: I've had headaches, sensitivity to light, and I get tired by the afternoon. My doctor has told me I have a concussion and I've been limiting screen time and resting.
Q: Have you received any treatment since the collision?
A: Yes, I was seen at an urgent care clinic that day and I have a follow-up with a neurologist scheduled.
Q: Is there anything else you want to add?
A: Only that I'm cooperating fully and I'd like updates on the repair estimate for my vehicle.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
